Sam: Quick round — best two-word compliment you can give a teammate, go!
Jules: Code whisperer
Anika: Snack diplomat
Rafe: Meeting ninja
Tess: Debug whisperer
Sam: love these. bonus: one-line why (optional)
Jules: Code whisperer because they make it compile on the first try. mythical.
Anika: Snack diplomat bc they broker pastries without casualties.
Rafe: Meeting ninja = quietly ends meetings 10 mins early.
Tess: Debug whisperer finds the missing semicolon like it's a treasure map.
Sam: OK vote with reactions for the compliment you want to receive this week. winner gets a mystery donut.
Jules: also tiny PSA — kitchen milk labeled, please double-check before heroic latte attempts.
Anika: noted. I will not be the milk bandit today.
Rafe: @Sam I nominate you as mystery-donut procurer should my reaction win :grin:
kudos-bot: Tess received a shoutout from Sam for helpful debugging earlier. +1 karma
Tess: thank you tiny badge of honor :sparkles:
Sam: poll ends in 20 min. last one-liner to inspire donuts: "Keep calm and pretend you committed the right change."
